capabilities: Writes amCharts 5 chart and map code that follows the library's current API
Looks up the reference for any chart type: XY, pie, map, stock, Gantt, flow, hierarchy, radar, timeline
Finds and returns complete working examples to start from
Looks up exact setting names and default values in the API reference
Finds the right map file for a country or region, with its CDN path and import
Explains and fixes common amCharts 5 mistakes, such as dates, axes, themes and disposal
defaultPrompt: Using amCharts 5, make a pie chart of these values: Apples 40, Pears 35, Plums 25.
Show me a working amCharts 5 Sankey diagram example I can start from.
Which amCharts 5 map file has the regions of France, and how do I import it?

positive.description: Build a pie chart page from given values
positive.prompt: Using amCharts 5, make a pie chart of these values: Apples 40, Pears 35, Plums 25. Put the complete HTML page in a code block.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns one complete HTML page that loads amCharts 5 from cdn.amcharts.com and builds an am5percent.PieChart with a PieSeries holding the three values; opened in a browser it shows the pie with labels and tooltips.

positive.description: Build a column chart with a cursor
positive.prompt: Using amCharts 5, make a column chart of the GDP of the five largest economies, with each column in a different color and a cursor. Put the complete HTML page in a code block.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a complete HTML page with an am5xy.XYChart, a category X axis, a value Y axis, a ColumnSeries whose columns each get their own color, and an am5xy.XYCursor; hovering a column shows its tooltip.

positive.description: Build a rotating globe with lines between cities
positive.prompt: Using amCharts 5, make a rotating globe, tilted toward the northern hemisphere, with lines connecting London, New York and Tokyo. Put the complete HTML page in a code block.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a complete HTML page with an am5map.MapChart using geoOrthographic, panX rotateX and panY rotateY, a negative rotationY tilt, am5geodata_worldLow, a MapPointSeries for the three cities and a MapLineSeries connecting them; the globe rotates and can be dragged.

positive.prompt: Which amCharts 5 map file has the states of Germany, and how do I import it?
positive.expected_behavior: Names germanyLow (16 states), with the CDN path geodata/germanyLow.js, the global am5geodata_germanyLow and the ES module import @amcharts/amcharts5-geodata/germanyLow.

positive.prompt: Show me a working amCharts 5 Sankey diagram example I can start from.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the full code of an amCharts Sankey example (for example examples/flow/sankey-diagram) using am5flow.Sankey, with its data.

negative.prompt: What is the capital of Lithuania?
Write a Python function that removes duplicates from a list while keeping the order.

negative.prompt: How do I insert a bar chart in Microsoft Excel?

publication.release_notes: 1.9.1 and 1.9.2: a JSON config reference for Chart Maker and the <am5-chart> element, maps included; the npm package's 62 JSON configs as examples; a recipe for a different fill pattern per column; amcharts.com docs and demo addresses accepted by the doc tools; shorter first answers from the long references, with the rest on request; and amCharts 5.21.4: resources for maps and locales in configs, themes with settings.
